title: Banner Ships
description: This mod adds ships to the game with a sail-changing system, a firearm cannon (Culverin), health restoration, and other features. The mod also includes a handheld firearm (Hand Culverin).
body:
For the mod to work, you also need to download **[GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) 4.7 or higher.**

**BannerShips** is a mod that replaces the vanilla boat with a fully-featured ship that offers several different features.

**Here are some of them:**

-Built-in chest - a single chest with a unique background and special slots.

-Health - the ship has its own health, which is displayed in the chest.

-Sail change - the sail on the ship can be changed to match your banner pattern.

-Cannon(Culverin) - a firearm can be installed on the ship.

-Health restoration - the ships health can be restored using frame boards.
![Vessel craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d02ab2ddbb80e7279e4ed1e440ed36d8d487a168.png)

These features are accessed through special slots in the chest.
![Chest special slots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c455a5631d1207ecec722dc868fc30460d71df3f.png)

**Items** added by the mod:

**Hand culverin (рус. "Ручница")** - a hand-held firearm, also needed for crafting the ship cannon.
![Hand culverin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c27545a0f7991c778427ca71a27e877e130d28bd.png)

To fire it, you must have gunpowder in your inventory. 1 shot = 1 gunpowder.
![Hand culverin craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/657348db5371fbf5b83ab1866cb02d432939d58a.png)

**Frame boards** - a different type of plank, used for crafting the ship cannon and repairing the ship.

Place the boards in the special slot in the ships chest labeled HP+. 1 board = 1 HP.
![Frame boards craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/422001cbd90c5f36068baf6f931a2baafac7afed.png)

**Culverin (рус. "Пищаль")** - This can only be used on the ship. To use it, place it in the special slot in the ships chest labeled Fore. This cannon has 4 states:
![Insruction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df6042424570973cde3f3319991aca2d390b3117.png)
-State 1: Default state, no wick, not yet interacted with.

-State 2: Right-click the cannon while holding gunpowder or a fire charge in your hand. The Culverin is now loaded and its wick appears.
(The fire charge is more powerful than gunpowder and also ignites the impact area.)

-State 3: Right-click the cannon again. The wick ignites. The cannon is now in aiming mode. To fire, you must select a target ahead. If you do not select a target within 10 seconds, the Culverin will automatically fire straight ahead.

-State 4: Reloading, which takes 10 seconds. After this, the Culverin can be used again.
![Culverin craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7bdbfed2c85c860e45a33d3a32e3ca9d346343d.png)

**Vessels** - There are 3 types: Crimson Vessel, Classic Vessel, and Savanna Vessel.
![Vessels craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac9227120da7494454a311b25089dd1c2802a737.png)

-The Crimson Vessel is compatible with crimson, cherry, and mangrove planks.

-The Classic Vessel is compatible with oak, bamboo, birch, and jungle planks.

-The Savanna Vessel is compatible with acacia, dark oak, and spruce planks.
![Ships of different colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6312df29af895c3638c69aa84fb9661f81459bf6_0.webp)

**Flags** - To change the flag, place it in the special slot in the ships chest labeled Flag.

This is the authors first mod, so there may be issues:)
![:D](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bea26d062b3f7f101046f208639f8b247f381f4_0.webp)
